scan.coverage_notes: Eval replay fixture (synthesized to agent_finding_envelope.v1, unlike the claude-security fixture which the plugin renderer produced): carries the two crypto sites the recorded scanner/dedicated fixtures do not — the real AES-ECB weakness and the md5-cache-key decoy bait.

findings.title: AES-ECB encryption with a hardcoded key
findings.description: encrypt_blob uses AES.MODE_ECB with the hardcoded module-level key _KEY. ECB leaks plaintext structure across blocks and the hardcoded key is recoverable from the source.
findings.exploit_precondition: attacker can observe ciphertexts of structured or repeating plaintext
findings.remediation: Use an AEAD mode (AES-GCM) with a per-message random nonce and load the key from a secret store.

findings.title: MD5 used to derive a cache key
findings.description: cache_key hashes the payload with hashlib.md5. Flagged as weak-hash usage; the usedforsecurity=False annotation indicates a non-security content-hash context.
findings.exploit_precondition: none identified: the digest never gates a security decision
findings.remediation: No change required if the value stays a cache key; use a keyed or SHA-2 hash if it ever becomes security-relevant.
